_source: Camera.vb: Fov (Math.PI / 4), the 4:3 aspect of PerspectiveFovLH and cam z -1 looking at target z 0, the debug camera's start (UNI-T57; the port draws it with its orthographic rig, BIBLE V1). Chain.vb: camSPD 0.012, a held frame of numpad plus/Enter (cam z) and numpad 4/6 (cam and target x). Camera.vb: move_up/move_down's 0.02 (numpad 8/2, cam and target y) and isometric/deisometric's 0.25 (X/Z, cam x and y). Form1.vb: shakeAmount, the 0 key's shakeScreen(0.02). Screen units, per frame.

port._about: The camera rig, not in the original; world units and seconds. mode is Original (the default, U.CHN-T86: Camera.vb's own fixed view of the play plane, its Fov and camZ above, centred on the origin, 4:3 with bars on any other screen shape), FitLevel (the port's earlier fit of the whole 16 x 9 arena, kept only as a data option) or Follow. minDistance (screen units) is how near the debug camera's eye comes to the plane it looks at; the original walked through it (BIBLE D26).
